title: UK walk-discovery candidates — research pass 1
purpose: 100 UK candidates selected for the experience of unexpectedly encountering them on foot. This is an editorial research batch, not a production import.
selection_rules: visible or meaningfully legible from public space
one concise architectural, industrial, historical or human hook
works as part of a walk rather than only as a ticketed destination
London deliberately excluded because the live catalogue is already exceptionally dense there
production_gate: exact and fuzzy duplicate check against data/spots.json
verify current access, survival and condition
verify every factual claim against authoritative sources
resolve existing Ci city/region slug and exact ne category
add coordinates, area, postcode, unique id and bbox validation
rewrite only after editorial review; do not overwrite authored live entries
